name: dusk-sky-lensflare
keep: KEEP — the making of the image, copy exactly:
· MEDIUM: a cinematic wide-angle photograph shot from a very low angle against a dramatic twilight sky, glossy retouched finish with a dreamlike composite quality.
· GROUND: a deep gradient dusk sky — indigo at the top fading to a pale horizon, streaked with wispy swirling cirrus — over wild grass and a low fringe of silhouetted bare trees.
· LIGHT: a bright pinpoint sun-flare high in the sky throwing lens flares and rim light, warm glow wrapping the subject against the cool sky.
· PALETTE: cool midnight blue and slate sky versus warm bronze-lit skin and sand-beige garments — a cold-versus-warm contrast.
· LENS: wide angle tilted upward with slight distortion, the expansive sky dominating and the subject kept low in the frame.
· TEXTURE: smooth and polished with faint atmospheric haze, soft grain and high dynamic range.
· No readable text, no letters, no numerals, no logo, no watermark anywhere.
